notes.title: 11-Feb-2022 v2.0 RELEASE (Leader Boards)
notes.content: Added Leader Boards for each of the 3 difficulty levels.

notes.title: v1.1 triplets-400, achievements include slower achievements
notes.content:
v1.1 is now active.

 When any achievement is earned, all lesser (slower) achievements for that same difficulty level are also earned.
 improved achievement images (for fastest achievement at each level).
 Triplets fastest achievement is now set to 400.
 Player can type Ctrl-Delete to erase all achievements for a clean restart.
